title: coreLang: read secret data on a networked application
description: A minimal, fully pinned coreLang scenario. An attacker who already has full access to an application tries to read a secret data object it contains. The confidentiality of that data is the target security property; the red team looking for a way to read it is doing its job, not breaking the lab's rules.

lab_policy.note: Experiment boundary: the red team may traverse any step of the three in-scope assets, up to 40 actions. This bounds the experiment; it says nothing about whether the target is secure.

target_security.label: The secret data cannot be read by the attacker

business_slo.label: Reading the secret should cost the attacker at least 6 steps from full application access
